derivation_notes: The parent's single-phase damage burden is refined by adding a latent degraded_stress_state that turns on when accumulated_crowding_damage persistently exceeds a tolerance-like threshold and then adds extra suppression to dN_dt. Its initial condition is set to zero because the stated initial damage is zero, placing the new state on a biologically consistent zero-effect set rather than artificially pre-activating the severe-stress branch.
change_summary: I relaxed the assumption that residual crowding damage has only one smooth effect on growth suppression. The successor adds a history-dependent severe-stress regime that activates after sustained damage crosses a tolerance scale, creating a sharper high-damage decline in dN_dt at the same instantaneous N and crowding_pressure.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: Residual crowding damage has one phase and one tolerance regime, so increasing damage only deepens suppression smoothly through the existing algebraic interaction.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Sustained crowding can push the population or habitat into a more degraded stress state—such as biofouling, oxygen depletion pockets, or chronic physiological impairment—after enough accumulated damage, causing the same additional damage to have a larger marginal effect than in the mild-stress regime.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: The successor reduces to the parent when severe_damage_suppression_strength = 0, or when stress_state_activation_rate = 0, or when damage_tolerance_threshold is far above the reached accumulated_crowding_damage so degraded_stress_state remains near zero.

response_change.parent_relation: At fixed intrinsic_growth_rate and carrying_capacity, dN_dt is reduced by current effective crowding_pressure and accumulated_crowding_damage with one shared damage burden, so suppression depends on damage magnitude but not on whether damage has crossed a qualitatively stronger stress regime.
response_change.child_relation: Retain the same crowding and damage variables but let the effect of accumulated_crowding_damage on dN_dt steepen after sustained damage exceeds a tolerance-like level, creating a stronger high-damage suppression regime at the same N and crowding_pressure.
response_change.observable_effect: Across trajectories with similar instantaneous N and crowding_pressure, mild residual damage causes only moderate suppression, whereas sufficiently large sustained damage produces a disproportionate drop in dN_dt that is sharper than the parent can match with one global parameter set.

evolution_contract.activation_condition: Visible when accumulated_crowding_damage reaches a non-negligible fraction of carrying_capacity after prolonged high crowding, especially with moderate to high crowding_pressure so trajectories sample both low-damage and high-damage portions of the same experiment.
evolution_contract.train_hidden_contrast: In training, the mechanism appears as gradual history dependence at moderate damage loads; in holdout with longer or more intense crowding episodes, the same law extends to a sharper collapse in growth once damage burden becomes large.
evolution_contract.continuation_path: Recover the parent by taking the added damage-threshold steepening strength to zero or moving the threshold beyond the observed damage range.
evolution_contract.promotion_reason: A threshold-like transition in physiological or habitat condition is itself history dependent and cannot be represented faithfully by the existing single linear damage burden without either discontinuously hard-coding the target map or losing persistence; one additional state can track a slower deterioration/tolerance-loss regime that activates only after sustained damage.
evolution_contract.domain_mechanism: Threshold-like activation of a persistent severe-stress regime by sustained accumulated damage
evolution_contract.scientific_mechanism: Sustained crowding can push the population or habitat into a more degraded stress state—such as biofouling, oxygen depletion pockets, or chronic physiological impairment—after enough accumulated damage, causing the same additional damage to have a larger marginal effect than in the mild-stress regime.
evolution_contract.difficulty_rationale: This embedding is harder than a coefficient-only correction because it introduces a thresholded, persistent internal regime whose activation depends on past damage exposure, so the target mapping changes shape across reachable damage loads rather than being globally rescaled.
evolution_contract.assumption_before: The parent assumes all accumulated crowding damage acts through one homogeneous burden with a single smooth effect on growth suppression.
evolution_contract.assumption_after: Accumulated damage can trigger a slower severe-stress regime that persists and adds extra suppression only after a tolerance-like damage threshold is crossed.
evolution_contract.parent_reduction: The successor reduces to the parent when severe_damage_suppression_strength = 0, or when stress_state_activation_rate = 0, or when damage_tolerance_threshold is far above the reached accumulated_crowding_damage so degraded_stress_state remains near zero.
evolution_contract.observable_signature: At fixed intrinsic_growth_rate and carrying_capacity, compare portions of trajectories with similar N and crowding_pressure but different accumulated_crowding_damage histories. The parent gives one smooth suppression law in damage_load, whereas the child shows modest suppression while damage_load is below the tolerance scale and then a distinctly steeper decline in dN_dt once prolonged damage activates degraded_stress_state. This contrast is observable only when trajectories actually reach moderate to high damage_load under sustained crowding.
evolution_contract.shortcut_blocked: A single refit of the parent parameters can only change the global smooth mapping from crowding_pressure and accumulated_crowding_damage to dN_dt. It cannot preserve the moderate-damage response while also creating an additional high-damage onset with persistent extra suppression at the same instantaneous N and crowding_pressure, because the parent has no state that remembers entry into a severe-stress regime beyond accumulated_crowding_damage itself.

evolution_plan.activation_condition: Visible when accumulated_crowding_damage reaches a non-negligible fraction of carrying_capacity after prolonged high crowding, especially with moderate to high crowding_pressure so trajectories sample both low-damage and high-damage portions of the same experiment.
evolution_plan.train_hidden_contrast: In training, the mechanism appears as gradual history dependence at moderate damage loads; in holdout with longer or more intense crowding episodes, the same law extends to a sharper collapse in growth once damage burden becomes large.
evolution_plan.continuation_path: Recover the parent by taking the added damage-threshold steepening strength to zero or moving the threshold beyond the observed damage range.
evolution_plan.promotion_reason: A threshold-like transition in physiological or habitat condition is itself history dependent and cannot be represented faithfully by the existing single linear damage burden without either discontinuously hard-coding the target map or losing persistence; one additional state can track a slower deterioration/tolerance-loss regime that activates only after sustained damage.
evolution_plan.gap_statement: The parent assumes all accumulated crowding damage acts through one homogeneous burden with a single smooth effect on growth suppression.
evolution_plan.baseline_assumption: Residual crowding damage has one phase and one tolerance regime, so increasing damage only deepens suppression smoothly through the existing algebraic interaction.
evolution_plan.scientific_mechanism: Sustained crowding can push the population or habitat into a more degraded stress state—such as biofouling, oxygen depletion pockets, or chronic physiological impairment—after enough accumulated damage, causing the same additional damage to have a larger marginal effect than in the mild-stress regime.
evolution_plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to relax the parent's single-phase damage assumption. The parent already allows delayed crowding and damage amplification, but its target mapping remains effectively one-phase: for any supplied crowding_pressure and accumulated_crowding_damage, one smooth suppression law applies everywhere. Vary the duration/intensity of prior crowding so that accumulated_crowding_damage ranges from small to substantial fractions of carrying_capacity, while holding intrinsic_growth_rate, carrying_capacity, and the observation protocol fixed. Then compare dN_dt at similar instantaneous N and crowding_pressure but different damage histories. Scientifically, many systems show a regime change once fouling or chronic stress becomes severe enough that tolerance collapses. The child should therefore create a stronger suppression regime that turns on only after sustained damage, not merely rescale the whole response. This is observable under the current ODE contract because accumulated_crowding_damage is already a state supplied to the solver and can become large after prolonged high crowding from the stated initial conditions. A single refit of the parent parameters can steepen or weaken suppression globally, but it cannot simultaneously preserve the parent's moderate-damage behavior and also create a distinct high-damage onset where the slope of dN_dt versus accumulated_crowding_damage becomes markedly more negative only beyond a reachable burden range. Limitation: if trajectories never accumulate appreciable damage relative to carrying_capacity, this refinement will remain weakly identified.

scenario_text: A closed population grows when rare but experiences progressively stronger crowding as abundance rises. The benchmark asks for the instantaneous rate of change in abundance along a continuous-time population trajectory. Birth and death conditions remain fixed, so density dependence is the only feedback controlling long-term abundance.
promotion_reason: A threshold-like transition in physiological or habitat condition is itself history dependent and cannot be represented faithfully by the existing single linear damage burden without either discontinuously hard-coding the target map or losing persistence; one additional state can track a slower deterioration/tolerance-loss regime that activates only after sustained damage.
